name: Maxis Berhad
summary: Maxis Berhad, an investment holding company, provides a suite of converged telecommunications, digital, and related services and solutions in Malaysia. It offers mobile and home plans; devices, such as phones, tablets, wearables, and home devices. The company also provides Internet of Things (IoT), network, cloud, security, and business communication solutions; energy savings solutions; hardware and software solutions for retailers; and managed network services and other network services. It serves retail, manufacturing, logistics, food and beverage, and financial service industries, as well as the public sector. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.…
